sentences.en: All of us have days when, despite our best efforts, everything just goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都有这样的时候：尽管我们做出了最大努力，但一切还是出了问题。
这是一个极其严重的问题。

sentences.en: Atul Gawande is a surgeon at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston.
sentences.zh: 阿图尔·加万迪是波士顿布里格姆妇女医院的一名外科医生。

sentences.en: You might have read his work in The New Yorker or in Slate.
sentences.zh: 你可能在《纽约客》或《Slate》杂志上读过他的作品。

sentences.en: A few years ago, Atul was at work operating on a patient he refers to as Mr. Hageman.
sentences.zh: 几年前，阿图尔正在为一位他称之为哈格曼先生的患者做手术。

sentences.en: I was taking out a tumor of the adrenal gland laparoscopically.
sentences.zh: 我当时在用腹腔镜切除一侧肾上腺肿瘤。

sentences.en: He'd performed this procedure dozens of times before, but this time was particularly tricky.
sentences.zh: 他以前做过几十次这种手术，但这次格外棘手。

sentences.en: Mr. Hageman's tumor was behind his liver, nestled tightly against an important blood vessel.
sentences.zh: 哈格曼先生的肿瘤长在肝脏后面，紧紧贴着一条重要的血管。

sentences.en: The main blood vessel returning the blood of the body to the heart.
sentences.zh: 那是将全身血液输送回心脏的主血管。

sentences.en: It's known as the vena cava.
Atul began the surgery, and everything was going smoothly.
sentences.zh: 阿图尔开始手术，一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: He was almost done detaching the tumor, when all of a sudden, he nicked the blood vessel.
sentences.zh: 他快要把肿瘤剥离完了，突然之间，他刮破了那条血管。

sentences.en: I ended up creating a hole in the vena cava, which meant that he then pretty quickly lost his entire blood volume into his abdomen.
sentences.zh: 我最终在下腔静脉上弄破了一个洞，这意味着他很快就失去了腹腔内所有的血液。

sentences.en: A complete blackout on the screen and utter chaos.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上一片漆黑，现场一片混乱。

sentences.en: Atul took the man's heart in his hand and began compressing it to keep blood flowing to his brain.
sentences.zh: 阿图尔用手托住那个男人的心脏，开始按压，以维持流向他大脑的血液。

sentences.en: I mean, he lost basically 10 times his body volume in blood, but we were able to give him enough blood to keep his circulation going.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他损失的血量基本上达到了他体重的10倍，但我们设法输了足够的血，维持了他的血液循环。

sentences.en: He had a cardiac arrest twice.
sentences.zh: 他经历了两次心脏骤停。

sentences.en: We were finally able to repair the hole in the vena cava, get the tumor out, and have him recover.
sentences.zh: 我们最终修补了下腔静脉上的洞，取出了肿瘤，并让他康复了。

sentences.en: A happy ending, and at first blush, a textbook case of medical heroics.
sentences.zh: 一个皆大欢喜的结局，初看之下，这是一起教科书式的医疗英雄主义事件。

sentences.en: A doctor makes a mistake, but he fixes it, taking a heart into his bare hands and squeezing life back into his patient's body.
sentences.zh: 医生犯了错，但他修复了错误，用双手捧起心脏，将生命重新挤回患者体内。

sentences.en: This is the stuff of countless movies and TV shows.
sentences.zh: 这正是无数电影和电视剧里的情节。

sentences.en: Our whole idea of the hero is the person who can kind of know it all, save the day on their own, just by force of their brain and their skill.
sentences.zh: 我们对英雄的全部概念，就是那种仿佛无所不知、仅凭一己之力以及他的聪明才智和技能就能拯救世界的人。

sentences.en: But skill and brain power were not the reason Mr. Hageman survived.
sentences.zh: 但哈格曼先生能够幸存，靠的并非技能和智力。

sentences.en: Atul says what actually saved his patient's life was a plan the surgical team had made before they began the surgery.
sentences.zh: 阿图尔说，实际上救了他患者性命的，是手术团队在开始手术前制定的一项计划。

sentences.en: The plan wasn't grand or complicated.
sentences.zh: 这个计划并不宏大，也不复杂。

sentences.en: In fact, it was a humble checkliSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它只是一张不起眼的核对清单。

sentences.en: And what happened was, when we ran the checklist, when we got to the part where we said, you know, what's the goal of the operation and tell me anything unexpected about this?
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的：当我们过清单时，到了我们说“你知道，手术的目标是什么，告诉我关于这台手术有什么意料之外的情况吗”的那一步时，

sentences.en: And I mentioned to the anesthesiologist that this tumor was pretty tightly against the vena cava.
sentences.zh: 我向麻醉师提到，这个肿瘤非常紧地贴着下腔静脉。

sentences.en: The anesthesiologist then made a plan to get more blood into the room, just in case.
sentences.zh: 麻醉师随后制定了一个计划，准备了更多的血备用，以防万一。

sentences.en: When disaster came, he was prepared.
sentences.zh: 当灾难降临时，他已经做好了准备。

sentences.en: And that was the only reason that this man got through it.
sentences.zh: 而这就是这个人能够挺过这一关的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Today on Hidden Brain, the subtle biases that cause very smart and very skilled people to become their own worst enemies.
sentences.zh: 今天在“隐藏大脑”节目中，我们将探讨那些导致极其聪明和熟练的人成为自己最大敌人的微妙偏见。

sentences.en: And how innovators have found a way to help pilots, doctors, frankly any of us, perform at our beSt.
sentences.zh: 以及创新者是如何找到一种方法，帮助飞行员、医生——坦率地说，帮助我们所有人——发挥出最佳水平的。

sentences.en: It's a story of an ancient insight applied to modern life.
sentences.zh: 这是一个将古老洞见应用于现代生活的故事。

sentences.en: And even though you might not know it, this innovation shapes life and death decisions that affect all of us.
sentences.zh: 尽管你可能并未察觉，但这项创新正在塑造影响我们所有人生死抉择的关键决策。

sentences.en: We begin in the depths of the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 我们从大萧条的深渊开始讲起。

sentences.en: It was a time of great suffering, and people were looking for inspiration.
sentences.zh: 那是一个苦难深重的时代，人们在寻找精神鼓舞。

sentences.en: Many found it in the heroes who were inventing the modern age of flight.
sentences.zh: 许多人在那些开创了现代飞行时代的英雄身上找到了这种鼓舞。

sentences.en: One effort in particular caught the public's attention.
sentences.zh: 其中有一项努力格外引人注目。

sentences.en: Boeing was developing an airplane that was said to be different from anything that came before it.
sentences.zh: 波音公司当时正在研发一款飞机，据说它与以往任何飞机都不同。

sentences.en: Closely guarded, the Army's newest bomber and America's largest land plane is prepared for its first flight at Seattle.
sentences.zh: 在严密保护下，陆军最新的轰炸机、美国最大的陆基飞机正准备在西雅图进行首次试飞。

sentences.en: In the press, the Model 299 was known as the Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 在媒体上，299型被称为“飞行堡垒”。

sentences.en: It weighs 15 tons and is reported to have cost nearly half a million.
sentences.zh: 它重达15吨，据报道造价接近50万美元。

sentences.en: Something like the Boeing 299 was a huge story.
sentences.zh: 像波音299这样的飞机是一条特大新闻。

sentences.en: Roger Conner is a curator at the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·康纳是华盛顿特区史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆的一名策展人。

sentences.en: We're standing in a part of the museum dedicated to the golden age of flight,
sentences.zh: 我们正站在博物馆里专门展示黄金飞行时代的一个展区，

sentences.en: gazing up at a model of Boeing's Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 抬头凝视着波音“飞行堡垒”的模型。

sentences.en: And is that the silver plane that we're looking at up high?
sentences.zh: 我们高处看到的那个银色飞机就是它吗？

sentences.en: Right, so a very streamlined, four-engine aircraft, and this was really a marvel of its day.
sentences.zh: 没错，这是一架非常流线的四引擎飞机，在当时这确实是一个奇迹。

sentences.en: In other words, the Model 299 was a big deal, both for Boeing and for the United States.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，无论是对波音公司还是对美国而言，299型都意义重大。

sentences.en: It was a success story in America that was really challenged by a depression.
sentences.zh: 这是美国一个在经济大萧条中依然充满挑战的成功故事。

sentences.en: It was also a very big deal for the U.S.
By all accounts, it's a wonder of technology.
sentences.zh: 从各方面来看，它都是一个科技奇迹。

sentences.en: So the Air Corps pilots that see it are in awe.
sentences.zh: 因此，看到它的航空兵飞行员都惊叹不已。
这是一架梦幻般的机器。

sentences.en: The plane arrived on the scene at a time when the nation was obsessed with the possibilities of flight.
sentences.zh: 这架飞机登场时，正值全国上下沉迷于飞行可能性的时期。

sentences.en: Air racing was not just a niche activity for wealthy hobbyists.
sentences.zh: 飞行比赛不仅仅是富裕业余爱好者的一个小众活动。

sentences.en: It was kind of a national craze and obsession.
sentences.zh: 它简直是一种全国性的狂热和痴迷。

sentences.en: The fastest things on wings strut their amazing stuff.
sentences.zh: 展翅高飞的速度之王们展示着他们惊人的风采。

sentences.en: You know, kids would obsess over who was leading the rankings at the Cleveland air races.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，孩子们会痴迷于谁在克利夫兰飞行比赛的排行榜上名列前茅。

sentences.en: The military was obsessed, too, with the idea of long-range bombers, planes that could better protect the U.S.
sentences.zh: 军方也同样痴迷于远程轰炸机的概念，即那些能够更好地保护美国海岸线、并在另一场大战爆发时赋予国家优势的飞机。

sentences.en: coastline and give the nation an edge if another great war erupted.
sentences.zh: 海岸线，并在另一场大战爆发时赋予国家优势。

sentences.en: In 1934, the Army Air Corps put out a proposal to the nation's aviation companies and challenged them to build a new long-range bomber for the military.
sentences.zh: 1934年，陆军航空兵向全国的航空企业发出了一份招标书，挑战他们为军方制造一款新的远程轰炸机。

sentences.en: The prototypes were to go up against each other at a flight competition the following year.
sentences.zh: 这些原型机将在第二年的飞行比赛中进行同台竞技。

sentences.en: The two leading competitors are Douglas and Boeing.
sentences.zh: 两个主要的竞争对手是道格拉斯和波音。

sentences.en: Douglas was really starting to dominate the American aircraft industry at this moment.
sentences.zh: 此时的道格拉斯正开始主导美国的飞机制造业。

sentences.en: Their DC-2 was becoming the hot passenger airliner and was quickly putting Boeing into the background in that industry.
sentences.zh: 他们的DC-2正在成为热门的客机，并迅速让波音在该行业中退居次席。

sentences.en: So once the Air Corps announces this new bomber competition, Boeing is really eager to show off and demonstrate that they can lead the pack.
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦航空兵宣布了这场新的轰炸机竞赛，波音就迫不及待地想要炫耀并证明他们能够引领群雄。

sentences.en: Boeing had a lot to prove.
sentences.zh: 波音有太多的实力需要证明了。

sentences.en: By the time the competition rolled around, it had an ace up its sleeve, the Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 当比赛来临之际，它手中握有一张王牌——“飞行堡垒”。

sentences.en: On October 30, 1935, the day of the competition, Boeing's streamlined silver behemoth was the clear frontrunner.
sentences.zh: 1935年10月30日，比赛当天的波音流线型银色庞然大物显然是领头羊。

sentences.en: The morning of the competition, flight teams from Boeing, Douglas, and Martin assembled with military leaders at Wright Field in Dayton, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 比赛当天早晨，来自波音、道格拉斯和马丁的飞行团队与军事领导人一起聚集在俄亥俄州代顿的莱特机场。

sentences.en: Early in the morning, well, 9 o'clock in the morning, and apparently, by all accounts, a very beautiful day.
sentences.zh: 清晨，嗯，上午9点左右，根据各方说法，这显然是个非常美好的日子。

sentences.en: So kind of ideal conditions for a late October day in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 对于俄亥俄州10月下旬的一天来说，可以说条件非常理想。

sentences.en: And perfect day for a test flight, really.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这绝对是进行试飞的完美一天。

sentences.en: A crowd watched as the Boeing 299 taxi to the runway.
sentences.zh: 人群注视着波音299号滑行到跑道上。

sentences.en: Advances the power, engines spool up, is rolling down the runway.
sentences.zh: 推大油门，发动机转速上升，在跑道上滑行。

sentences.en: The beautiful airplane lifted into the air.
sentences.zh: 这架美丽的飞机腾空而起。

sentences.en: It had all the makings of a winner.
sentences.zh: 它具备了一架获胜飞机的所有特质。

sentences.en: And then the observers note that the aircraft starts to abruptly pitch up.
sentences.zh: 然后，观察员们注意到飞机开始急剧抬头。

sentences.en: So as it takes off, rather than kind of gradually rising and building up speed, the nose just starts to pick up and up.
sentences.zh: 因此，在起飞时，机头并没有逐渐抬高和加速，而是开始不断向上抬起。

sentences.en: And immediately, observers on the ground realize something's wrong.
sentences.zh: 地面上的观察员立刻意识到出事了。
在300英尺的高度，飞机失速了。

sentences.en: As people watched in horror, the flying fortress began to plummet toward the earth.
sentences.zh: 在人们惊恐的注视下，“飞行堡垒”开始向地面坠落。

sentences.en: Impacts the ground in a flat attitude and bursts into flames.
sentences.zh: 以平直的姿态撞击地面并燃起大火。

sentences.en: There were five crewmen on board.
sentences.zh: 机上当时有五名机组人员。

sentences.en: Major Ployer Hill, who was the chief of flight test for Wright Field.
sentences.zh: 普洛耶·希尔少校，他是莱特机场的飞行测试主管。

sentences.en: Leslie Tower, who was the chief of flight test pilot.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利·托尔，他是首席试飞员。

sentences.en: There was also Donald Tutt, who was acting as the co-pilot.
sentences.zh: 还有担任副驾驶的唐纳德·图特。

sentences.en: There was a mechanic on board, Mark Coogler, and John Cutting, who was one of the aeronautical engineers involved with the program.
sentences.zh: 机上还有一名机械师马克·库格勒，以及参与该项目的航空工程师约翰·卡丁。

sentences.en: Observers on the ground raced toward the wreck.
sentences.zh: 地面的观察员们朝残骸冲去。

sentences.en: Obviously, an aircraft like this has a lot of fuel on board.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这样一架飞机机载燃油非常多。

sentences.en: And so when, in this case, because the aircraft came down relatively flat, it only just started to spin in.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种情况下，由于飞机降落时相对平稳，它只是刚刚开始旋转坠毁。

sentences.en: And it would have been fairly apparent to the people on the ground that there was a good chance of survivors.
sentences.zh: 对于地面上的人来说，生还的几率很大，这一点应该是显而易见的。

sentences.en: So it's kind of a worst-case scenario where you see that the aircraft is involved in terms of being on fire.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一种最糟糕的情况：你看到飞机着火了，

sentences.en: But you know there's people on there that are likely still alive.
sentences.zh: 但你知道上面的人很可能还活着。

sentences.en: So it's going to be a great hazard to both the rescuers as well as the occupants of the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 所以这对救援人员以及机上人员来说都将是巨大的危险。

sentences.en: Three of those occupants survived, but two died, Ployer Hill and Leslie Tower.
sentences.zh: 机上有三人幸存，但两人丧生，即普洛耶·希尔和莱斯利·托尔。
两人都是经验极其丰富的飞行员。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, people asked, what made the Flying Fortress crash?
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻有人发问：是什么导致了“飞行堡垒”的坠毁？

sentences.en: This aircraft did have an autopilot, and not unlike a lot of accidents today, attention centered on that.
sentences.zh: 这架飞机确实配有自动驾驶仪，和当今许多事故一样，注意力集中在了这一点上。

sentences.en: So was the autopilot somehow engaged where it was overriding the inputs of the crew members?
sentences.zh: 那么，是否是自动驾驶仪在某种程度上被接通了，从而覆盖了机组人员的操纵指令？

sentences.en: So that was one focus of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是调查的重点之一。

sentences.en: But very quickly, attention turned to a control locking mechanism, which was, that was one of the advanced features of this aircraft,
sentences.zh: 但很快，人们的注意力转向了一个操纵面锁定机构，这也是该飞机先进的功能之一，

sentences.en: was that it had its own built-in mechanism for locking the elevator for when it was essentially parked on the ground.
sentences.zh: 即它拥有自己的内置机构，用于在飞机基本上停在地面上时锁定升降舵。

sentences.en: The elevator determines the pitch of the plane, basically the movement of the nose up or down.
sentences.zh: 升降舵决定了飞机的俯仰角，也就是机头上下的运动。

sentences.en: For most planes at the time, elevator locks were on the outside, meaning ground crew had to unlock them before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 对于当时的大多数飞机来说，升降舵锁在外部，这意味着地勤人员必须在起飞前将其解锁。

sentences.en: But in the Model 299, the elevator lock was inside the cabin of the plane.
sentences.zh: 但在299型飞机中，升降舵锁在机舱内部。

sentences.en: The crew had forgotten to unlock it.
sentences.zh: 机组人员忘记将其解锁了。

sentences.en: And so after the plane took off, the pilots found they couldn't level off.
sentences.zh: 因此在飞机起飞后，飞行员发现他们无法将其改平。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, in the, you know, just the matter of the few seconds that they're airborne, there's just not enough time to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在他们身处空中的这短短几秒钟内，根本没有足够的时间来处理这个问题。

sentences.en: So less than 20 seconds between the time the wheels leave the ground and the aircraft is entering the stalls,
sentences.zh: 因此，从机轮离开地面到飞机进入失速状态，时间不到20秒，

sentences.en: it's just not enough time for that awareness to dawn, be able to reach the controls,
sentences.zh: 根本没有足够的时间让他们意识到情况、能够触及操纵装置，

sentences.en: particularly as the, you know, aircraft is beginning to stall,
sentences.zh: 特别是当飞机开始失速时，

sentences.en: then the ability of somebody to find the controls and solve the problem,
sentences.zh: 那么一个人去寻找操纵装置并解决问题的能力，

sentences.en: it's too late and they may not be able to physically do it because they're getting thrown around the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 就为时已晚了，而且他们可能无法在物理上做到这一点，因为他们在飞机里被甩来甩去。

sentences.en: The death of the two men was a crushing blow.
sentences.zh: 这两人的丧生是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: For military leaders and the aviation industry, the crash prompted an unsettling question.
sentences.zh: 对于军事领导人和航空业来说，这次坠机引发了一个令人不安的问题。

sentences.en: If experienced pilots like Ployer Hill and Leslie Tower could make fatal mistakes with the Flying Fortress,
sentences.zh: 如果像普洛耶·希尔和莱斯利·托尔这样经验丰富的飞行员也会在“飞行堡垒”上犯下致命错误，

sentences.en: what did that mean for the future of manned air flight?
sentences.zh: 那这对于载人飞行的未来意味着什么？

sentences.en: Were planes simply becoming too complicated to fly?
sentences.zh: 难道飞机变得太复杂而无法驾驶了吗？

sentences.en: At this moment in the mid-1930s, the performance of aircraft are changing so rapidly,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪30年代中期这个时刻，飞机的性能变化如此之快，

sentences.en: there's so many new complex systems coming into play, rather delicate systems in some ways.
sentences.zh: 有那么多复杂的新系统投入使用，在某些方面甚至是相当脆弱的系统。

sentences.en: So everything from retractable landing gear to turbochargers for engines,
sentences.zh: 因此，从可收放起落架到发动机涡轮增压器，无一不包，

sentences.en: all of which require their own detailed specifications for operation.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都需要它们自己详细的操作规范。

sentences.en: And so now a pilot was beginning to become overwhelmed with the degree of complexity with all these systems
sentences.zh: 因此，当时飞行员开始被所有这些系统的复杂程度以及它们如何相互影响所压倒，

sentences.en: and how they interfaced with one another.
sentences.zh: 以及它们之间是如何相互对接的。

sentences.en: It became difficult to keep them straight.
sentences.zh: 要把它们理清楚变得很困难。

sentences.en: To many of us, the instinctive solution to this problem might be more training.
sentences.zh: 对我们许多人来说，解决这个问题的本能方案可能是进行更多的培训。

sentences.en: Spend more time in the plane.
sentences.zh: 在飞机上花更多的时间。

sentences.en: Get to know it like you know your own home.
sentences.zh: 像了解自己的家一样了解它。

sentences.en: Understand its quirks inside and out.
sentences.zh: 里里外外了解它的脾气。

sentences.en: But Rogers says that kind of thinking may not have saved the men who died in the crash.
sentences.zh: 但罗杰说，那种想法可能并没有拯救在坠机中丧生的这些人。

sentences.en: The pilots actually had lots of experience with the plane.
sentences.zh: 飞行员实际上对这架飞机有着丰富的经验。

sentences.en: They had been flying it for several months.
sentences.zh: 他们已经驾驶它好几个月了。

sentences.en: Things had become rather routine in testing this aircraft.
sentences.zh: 在测试这架飞机时，事情已经变得相当例行公事。

sentences.en: So certainly the crew, both at Wright Field and with Boeing, were fairly familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论是莱特机场的机组人员还是波音公司的机组人员，对它都相当熟悉。

sentences.en: They had clearly become quite comfortable with the operation of the aircraft
sentences.zh: 他们显然对飞机的操作感到非常适应，

sentences.en: and were used to its quirks and how it performed.
sentences.zh: 并且习惯了它的脾气以及它的性能表现。

sentences.en: So if more training wasn't the answer, what was?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果更多的培训不是答案，那什么才是？

sentences.en: The solution that military leaders devised was fundamentally about human psychology.
sentences.zh: 军事领导人设计出的解决方案从根本上讲是关于人类心理学的。

sentences.en: Pilots were not screwing up because they were incompetent.
sentences.zh: 飞行员把事情搞砸并不是因为他们无能。

sentences.en: They were screwing up because they were very good.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以搞砸，是因为他们本身非常优秀。

sentences.en: So good that they were completely sure they knew what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 优秀到他们坚信自己对在做的事情了如指掌。

sentences.en: They didn't feel the need to slow down, go over the basics,
sentences.zh: 他们觉得没必要放慢节奏、重温基础，

sentences.en: like unlocking the elevator before taking off.
sentences.zh: 比如起飞前解锁升降舵。

sentences.en: The military responded with a new idea that was actually an old idea.
sentences.zh: 军方给出了一个新点子，其实也就是个老点子。

sentences.en: In the cockpit, you learn to follow the checklist
sentences.zh: 在驾驶舱里，你学会了遵循检查单

sentences.en: because it helps you to keep your mind on your work.
sentences.zh: 因为这能帮你把注意力集中在工作上。

sentences.en: Detail's important when you're flying a big bomber.
sentences.zh: 驾驶大型轰炸机时，细节至关重要。

sentences.en: And using the checklist means you don't overlook a thing.
sentences.zh: 使用检查单意味着你不会遗漏任何事情。

sentences.en: This is from a 1943 military training film.
sentences.zh: 这段视频出自1943年的一部军事训练片。

sentences.en: After you get the plane off the ramp and down near the runway,
sentences.zh: 当你把飞机开离斜坡并靠近跑道后，
你就准备好进行试车了。

sentences.en: One of the most important checks of all.
sentences.zh: 这是所有检查中最重要的一项。

sentences.en: That gets all your props safe over concrete for the run-up.
sentences.zh: 这样试车时，所有的螺旋桨就都在水泥地面上方了。

sentences.en: And if there's a guy behind you, you won't blast him when you rev him up.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你身后有人，轰油门时也不会把气浪吹到他身上。

sentences.en: What's fascinating is you look at the effort that went into training these guys.
sentences.zh: 让人着迷的是，看看培训这些人所付出的努力。

sentences.en: The training videos that came out at that time are really magnificent.
sentences.zh: 当时出品的训练视频真的很棒。

sentences.en: They're frankly, you'd be hard-pressed to find something as well-produced today
sentences.zh: 坦白说，要想在今天找到制作同样精良、
用于相同目的的东西，你会很难办。

sentences.en: Checklists like these were widely implemented in the military
sentences.zh: 在波音299坠毁后的几年里，

sentences.en: in the years after the Boeing 299 crash.
sentences.zh: 这类检查单在军队中得到了广泛推行。

sentences.en: They cover tasks that, to a trained pilot, might seem mind-numbingly obvious.
sentences.zh: 它们涵盖的任务对受过训练的飞行员来说，可能显得枯燥得显而易见。

sentences.en: Make sure your crew is in the right position and that the hatches are closed.
sentences.zh: 确保机组人员在正确的位置，舱门已关闭。

sentences.en: Make sure your flight controls and tailwheel are unlocked.
sentences.zh: 确保飞行操纵装置和尾轮已解锁。

sentences.en: Check that your brakes have air pressure, that your warning lights work.
sentences.zh: 检查刹车是否有气压，警告灯是否工作。

sentences.en: A supercharger that's set correctly to low blower.
sentences.zh: 增压器正确设置为低增压档。

sentences.en: Your altimeter set to the correct field elevation.
sentences.zh: 高度表设置为正确的机场海拔高度。

sentences.en: You have them in your full rich position.
You want it in the cold position for maximum performance.
sentences.zh: 为了获得最大性能，你希望它处于冷空气位置。

sentences.en: So, to be honest, as somebody who doesn't know how to fly an aircraft,
sentences.zh: 说实话，作为一个不会开飞机的人，

sentences.en: a lot of this is gobbledygook to me.
sentences.zh: 这里面很多对我来说都是天书。

sentences.en: But I'm imagining that for most people who are pilots, this stuff is actually completely routine.
sentences.zh: 但我猜对大多数飞行员来说，这些其实都是常规操作。

sentences.en: That this is no different than me getting into my car in the morning and saying,
sentences.zh: 这跟我早晨上车、然后对自己说：

sentences.en: open the door, sit down, and close the door behind you.
sentences.zh: 开车门，坐下，随手关上车门，没什么两样。

sentences.en: That it seems really basic stuff.
sentences.zh: 这看起来确实是很基础的东西。

sentences.en: And I would imagine that if someone were to tell me to do that when I got into my car each morning,
sentences.zh: 我想如果有人在我每天早晨上车时告诉我要这么做，

sentences.en: I would say, what kind of bureaucratic nonsense is this?
sentences.zh: 我会说，这是什么官僚主义的废话？

sentences.en: I know how to fly a plane.

sentences.zh: 我是个有经验的飞行员。

sentences.en: Stop telling me how to do my job.
So, this has been a huge problem in aviation culture.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一直是航空文化中的一个巨大问题。

sentences.en: And it's one that does crop up.
sentences.zh: 而且这个问题确实时有发生。

sentences.en: In other words, checklists can help experts slow down, but only if the experts bother to listen.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，检查单可以帮助专家放慢节奏，但前提是专家愿意听取。

sentences.en: It turns out lots of pilots didn't want to listen.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，很多飞行员并不想听。

sentences.en: Harness another large bias in the brain.
sentences.zh: 利用人脑中另一个巨大的偏见。

sentences.en: Our willingness to be swept up by stories.
sentences.zh: 我们乐于被故事所吸引的倾向。

sentences.en: There are so many accounts now of episodes where people have winged the checklist or not paid attention,
sentences.zh: 现在有太多这样的报道：人们草率对待检查单或没有集中注意力，

sentences.en: So, particularly in commercial aviation and over the last half century,
sentences.zh: 因此，特别是在过去半个世纪的商业航空中，

sentences.en: there's been a very strong cultural emphasis on, really, storytelling,
sentences.zh: 文化上非常强调讲故事，

sentences.en: that you go and look at these accidents.
sentences.zh: 也就是去研究这些事故。

sentences.en: So, Air Florida, 1982, here in Washington, D.C., is a very famous one.
sentences.zh: 比如1982年华盛顿特区的佛罗里达航空空难，就是一个非常著名的例子。

sentences.en: Report on the airliner down off the 14th Street Bridge on Mach 417.
sentences.zh: 关于14街大桥附近飞机坠毁在麦克阿瑟417号上的报告。

sentences.en: There's the crash over the Everglades where they were focused on the nose gear.
sentences.zh: 还有他们关注前起落架的大沼泽地坠机事件。

sentences.en: There's a whole series of very well-known accidents that are brought up in training at various points
sentences.zh: 在培训的各个阶段都会提出一系列非常著名的事故，

sentences.en: that are discussed during simulator exercises and are omnipresent, really, in the literature.
sentences.zh: 在模拟器训练中进行讨论，并且在相关文献中真正无处不在。

sentences.en: So, there are inevitably a number of points where a commercial airline pilot will have witnessed these cockpit recreations
sentences.zh: 因此，商业航空公司飞行员在某种程度上不可避免地会目睹这些驾驶舱重现，

sentences.en: and seen the voice transcripts of various episodes where crews have kind of winged it.
sentences.zh: 并看到机组人员草率行事的各种插曲的语音记录。

sentences.en: They've flown by the seat of the pants.
They've not followed procedures, not used the checklist in the right way,
sentences.zh: 他们没有遵循程序，没有正确使用检查单，

sentences.en: and something bad's come about it.
sentences.zh: 结果导致了不好的事情发生。

sentences.en: The commercial aviation industry developed a culture of making and using checklists
sentences.zh: 商业航空业通过培训、模拟和讲故事，
培养了制定和使用检查单的文化。

sentences.en: The military went a step further and harnessed broader themes, patriotism, freedom.
sentences.zh: 军方则更进一步，利用了更广泛的主题：爱国主义、自由。

sentences.en: Men of the Army, Navy, and Marines reinforce the battlefronts on six continents
sentences.zh: 陆军、海军和海军陆战队的士兵增援了六个大陆的战场，

sentences.en: to save the homes and ideals of free men from Axis domination.
sentences.zh: 以拯救自由人的家园和理想免受轴心国的统治。

sentences.en: Despite the crash in Dayton, the Army ended up ordering thousands of Boeing's Model 299,
sentences.zh: 尽管代顿发生了坠机事故，陆军最终还是订购了数千架波音299型机，

sentences.en: Once the nation entered World War II, thousands of young, would-be pilots put up their hands to fly those planes.
sentences.zh: 一旦国家进入二战，成千上万年轻的准飞行员就举手要求驾驶这些飞机。

sentences.en: Each of the young cadets is to get real flying instruction
sentences.zh: 根据陆军的新计划，每个西点军校的本科生都将获得一定程度的空中体验，

sentences.en: under the Army's new plan of giving every undergraduate at West Point a certain amount of air experience.
sentences.zh: 年轻的学员们将接受真正的飞行指导。

sentences.en: They're all for it, too, and what a fine-looking group of young men they are.
sentences.zh: 他们也非常赞同，这群年轻人看起来真精神。

sentences.en: Modern warfare will be fought as much in the air as on the ground.
sentences.zh: 现代战争将在空中和地面同时进行。

sentences.en: And the new War Department policy looks to the time when every Army officer
sentences.zh: 战争部的新政策着眼于未来，届时每一位陆军军官

sentences.en: will be trained to fly as an observer, if not as a pilot.
sentences.zh: 都将接受培训，即使不作为飞行员，也要作为观察员飞行。

sentences.en: Many of these new pilots were not officers, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，许多这些新飞行员并不是军官。
许多人是年轻的应征入伍者。

sentences.en: Most of whom were, you know, 19, 20-year-olds, literally fresh off the farm,
sentences.zh: 他们大多是19、20岁左右的年轻人，可以说是刚从农场出来，

sentences.en: you know, with not a great deal of training.
sentences.zh: 而且没有接受过太多的培训。

sentences.en: And so they're going to be operating very complex systeMs.
sentences.zh: 因此他们将操作非常复杂的系统。

sentences.en: In a lot of cases, the aircraft are even getting more complicated than a Boeing 299.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，飞机的复杂程度甚至超过了波音299。

sentences.en: For these new pilots, checklists served as a safety net.
sentences.zh: 对于这些新飞行员来说，检查单就像是一张安全网。

sentences.en: They helped them get these massive planes off the ground.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助这些庞大的飞机离开地面。

sentences.en: They were used by flight teams to troubleshoot problems in the air.
sentences.zh: 飞行团队用它们来排除空中的故障。

sentences.en: And perhaps most importantly, they helped exhausted pilots avoid mistakes
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，它们帮助筋疲力尽的飞行员避免犯错，

sentences.en: while returning home from a mission.
sentences.zh: 在完成任务返航时安全着陆。

sentences.en: We can't know for sure how the use of checklists affected America's success in the war.
sentences.zh: 我们无法确切知道检查单对美国在战争中的成功产生了多大影响。

sentences.en: But Roger is sure that they saved lives.
sentences.zh: 但罗杰确信它们拯救了生命。

sentences.en: If those checklists had not been integrated to that level at the start of World War II,
sentences.zh: 如果在二战开始时这些检查单没有被整合到这种程度，

sentences.en: it's reasonable to assume that many hundreds and probably thousands of lives
sentences.zh: 可以合理推测，会有好几百甚至数千条生命

sentences.en: would have been lost due to that.
Today, checklists are essential to the aviation world.
sentences.zh: 如今，检查单对航空世界至关重要。

sentences.en: In fact, they're a big reason commercial aviation is significantly safer than driving your car on a highway.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这也是商业航空比在公路上开车安全得多的一个重要原因。

sentences.en: Checklists have become ubiquitous in lots of other fields, too.
sentences.zh: 检查单在许多其他领域也变得无处不在。

sentences.en: Fields where the work is complex and the cost of mistakes is high.
sentences.zh: 在这些领域，工作复杂且犯错代价高昂。

sentences.en: Construction crews now rely on checklists to build high-rise office towers.
sentences.zh: 建筑施工队现在依靠检查单来建造高层办公楼。

sentences.en: NASA has detailed to-do lists for astronauts.
sentences.zh: 美国宇航局为宇航员制定了详细的待办事项清单。

sentences.en: And then, there's the world of medicine.
I don't get through a week of surgery without us catching something
sentences.zh: 我一周的每一台外科手术都离不开我们的纠错，

sentences.en: that would have meant the patient didn't get as good care as they would have otherwise.
sentences.zh: 否则患者就无法获得原本应有的优质护理。

sentences.en: Coming up, how the powerful culture of aviation checklists has inspired
sentences.zh: 接下来，强大的航空检查单文化如何启发

sentences.en: and antagonized the field of medicine,
and how one grieving mother's question helped to change an entire culture.
sentences.zh: 以及一位悲痛母亲的质问如何改变了整个文化。

sentences.en: Atul Kawande is a surgeon at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston
sentences.zh: 阿图尔·加万德是波士顿布里格姆妇女医院的外科医生，

sentences.en: and the author of the Checklist Manifesto.
sentences.zh: 也是《检查单宣言》的作者。

sentences.en: When he began his career in medicine,
sentences.zh: 当他开始自己的医学职业生涯时，

sentences.en: checklists weren't something Atul spent a lot of time thinking about.
sentences.zh: 检查单并不是阿图尔花很多时间去思考的事情。

sentences.en: He was drawn to the heroics of doctors,
sentences.zh: 他被医生的英雄主义所吸引，

sentences.en: people who, through the force of their intellect and the rigor of their training,
sentences.zh: 这些人凭借他们的智力和严谨的训练，

sentences.en: could triumph over death and restore patients to productive lives.
sentences.zh: 能够战胜死神，让患者重获充满活力的人生。

sentences.en: I went into medicine because I wanted to be able to understand
sentences.zh: 我学医是因为我想弄明白

sentences.en: how does the body work, how does it go wrong,
sentences.zh: 身体是如何工作的，哪里会出错，

sentences.en: and then how can I come in and save the day.
sentences.zh: 然后我该如何介入并拯救大局。

sentences.en: And what I was really drawn to was in surgery,
sentences.zh: 而我真正被吸引的是外科手术，

sentences.en: where, you know, it's especially visceral.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那里的感受特别真切。

sentences.en: It's like, how do I save this person with my own hands?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我如何用自己的双手拯救这个人？

sentences.en: Over the years, though, Atul started to realize that daring and intellect weren't enough,
sentences.zh: 然而多年来，阿图尔开始意识到，胆识和智力是不够的，

sentences.en: particularly as medicine has become more complicated
sentences.zh: 特别是随着医学变得越来越复杂，

sentences.en: and doctors have evolved into what he calls super, super specialists.
sentences.zh: 医生已经演变成他所说的超级超级专家。

sentences.en: I am one of those super, super specialists now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就是那些超级超级专家之一。

sentences.en: I am a general surgeon in my original training,
sentences.zh: 我最初接受的是普通外科培训，

sentences.en: but then I've narrowed into not only a cancer surgery,
sentences.zh: 但后来我不仅缩小到了癌症手术，

sentences.en: but a focus on three specific tumors that make me, you know,
sentences.zh: 还专注于三种特定的肿瘤，这让我，

sentences.en: feel like I have an area where I can know more than just about anybody,
sentences.zh: 觉得自己拥有了一个领域，在那里我可以比几乎任何人知道得都多，
至少在地区层面上是这样，对吧？

sentences.en: So the problem is that even then,
sentences.zh: 所以问题在于，即便如此，

sentences.en: I'm not necessarily able to pull together in that moment in time
sentences.zh: 在那个特定的时刻，我也未必能把
所有可能重要的事情都综合起来。

sentences.en: Even a super, super specialist can screw up.
sentences.zh: 即使是超级超级专家也会搞砸。

sentences.en: Having advanced training doesn't guarantee perfection.
sentences.zh: 拥有高级培训并不能保证完美。

sentences.en: It's still possible that you'll forget something important,
sentences.zh: 你仍然可能会忘记重要的事情，

sentences.en: overlook a problem until it's too late,
sentences.zh: 忽视问题直到为时已晚，

sentences.en: even though you've done the same kind of surgery dozens of times.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种手术你已经做过几十次了。

sentences.en: Atul's search for a solution led him to the aviation world
sentences.zh: 阿图尔对解决方案的探寻将他带到了航空界

sentences.en: We famously hold up the airline industry
sentences.zh: 我们总是津津乐道地推崇航空业

sentences.en: as an example of high reliability performance.
sentences.zh: 作为高可靠性表现的一个例子。

sentences.en: You can have planes that are of now immense complexity,
sentences.zh: 现在的飞机复杂得不可思议，

sentences.en: and we have a far lower crash rate
sentences.zh: 而我们的坠机率却要低得多，

sentences.en: than when they were far simpler.
sentences.zh: 远低于飞机还很简单的时候。

sentences.en: And, you know, less than one in 200,000 flights
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，不到二十万分之一的航班

sentences.en: have any kind of a mishap and so on.
sentences.zh: 会发生任何类型的事故等等。

sentences.en: He studied that 1935 crash of the Flying Fortress.
sentences.zh: 他研究了1935年“飞行堡垒”的坠机事件。

sentences.en: He couldn't help but compare the military's response
sentences.zh: 他忍不住将军方的反应

sentences.en: to the way his own field responds to fatal errors.
sentences.zh: 与他自己的领域应对致命错误的方式进行了比较。

sentences.en: If we were looking at solving this problem
sentences.zh: 如果我们用解决这个问题的方式

sentences.en: the way we would solve it in medicine,
well, let's have a four-year training fellowship
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们开展一个为期四年的培训进修项目，

sentences.en: in how to fly the B-17 bomber.
